children: MacroGenics released an updated corporate presentation highlighting clinical program developments and $288 million in cash and investments as of September 30, 2026.
MGC026’s SCCHN cohort showed a 27.3% best overall response rate and 63.6% disease control rate among 22 patients.
MacroGenics plans to continue MGC026 enrollment in SCCHN and other tumor cohorts; its next update is anticipated in mid-2027.
For lorigerlimab in clear cell gynecologic cancer, the company reported a 25% confirmed response rate among 16 evaluable patients.
MGC028 completed Phase 1 dose escalation with no dose-limiting toxicities reported; an interim clinical update is anticipated in the first half of 2027.
The company cited cash runway guidance through 2028 and $359 million in non-dilutive capital generated in 2025–2026.

title: MacroGenics Updates Clinical Pipeline, Reports $288M in Cash and Runway Through 2028
